about: DESIGN 5.1 embark loadout for steps.lua. roles: one per starting dwarf, skills as df.job_skill names with target levels (1 pick per level, Run 6: 10 picks per dwarf; picks left over go to the first unfinished skill). items/animals: 'add' clicks on top of DF's default 'Prepare carefully' list (Run 6 default: 2 picks, 2 battle axes, 1 anvil, seeds, drink, food, about 218 wood); a click counts only if points_remaining drops. rest: bought in this order until a click no longer lowers the points, so no point stays unspent. Names are matched in the screen text (alt = fallbacks); exact row labels are [LIVE-UNTESTED].
